title: Notre Dame Nashville with Gym & Pool
description:
Notre Dame Nashville is a beautiful and classy two bedroom apartment  in the heart of the music city of Nashville. Close to every main attraction in Nashville from restaurants to bars,live music venues,recreational centers,schools,malls etc. NOTRE Dame is equipped with FREE HIGH SPEED WI-FI .You are in the right place. You have the entire apartment to yourself,kitchen,bathroom,living room all inclusive.

The space
Brand New Construction!!

Inside Notre Dame Nashville:

HIGH SPEED FREE WIFI

-This is a beautiful apartment with all high end finishes you’d expect.This  1bd unit is situated in a 11-story building with elevator access.

Interior Features:
-9-foot ceiling, designer lighting, high end window furnishings, wood-style plank flooring, nest thermostats
, and modern finishes.

Master Bedroom:
-King Size bed in master bedroom with XL pillows/throws, tv,work desk also features walk in closets.. walk in shower and bath tub attached to room

Living Room:
-Equipped with a 65 inch Smart TV,Fast/high speed internet, nest thermostat, lamps and modern furniture.

Kitchen:
-An expansive gourmet style kitchen with European style cabinetry, quartz countertop, refrigerator with freezer/ice machine, silent/quiet dishwasher and stove, coffee maker, rice cooker, kettle,utensils, cups, plates, bowls, mugs, wine opener, wine glasses, knives, cooking pots.

Bathroom:
-Towels, washcloths, shampoo, hand soap, body wash, toilet roll, paper towel, hair dryer.

Appliances:
-Dishwasher, Microwave, Refrigerator / Freezer, Washer and Dryer,Iron, kettle, rice cooker. 

Location:
-Gulch Surroundings
-Walkable to Restaurants,Wine bars & Cafes.
-Less than a mile to BROADWAY.
-9mins to Nashville International Airport.
-Extremely Safe neighborhood.

Building Access:
-You will have a key fob all through your stay to give you access everywhere on the property.

***DEALS ***DEALS ***DEALS
-FOR LONG TERM BOOKING DEALS PLEASE REACH OUT TO ME.

Guest access
Guests have access to Swimming Pool, Games room, Courtyard, Fitness Center..

Other things to note
This is strictly non-smoking apartment and host reserves the right to charge a fee of $350 and remove guest from property for any sort of violation.
